name: HFC
summary: Shenzhen HFC Co., Ltd. engages in the research, development, manufacturing, and sales of thermal management materials and EMC materials in China. Its products include graphene thermal pad, carbon fiber thermal pad, compatible metal thermal pad, and thermal interface materials. The company serves the communication, consumption terminal, smart automotive, datacenter, and new energy storage industries. The company was founded in 2003 and is based in Shenzhen, China.
